title: BSI Core Metadata Schema
description: Core metadata schema for Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao datasets, aligned to Dublin Core and Dublin Core Terms. Expressed in JSON Schema Draft-07.

required_metadata.title: Required metadata fields
required_metadata.description: List of required metadata fields for this MWLR Core Metadata Schema.

resourceType.title: Resource Type
resourceType.description: The nature or genre of the resource, from the DCMI Type Vocabulary. Limited subset used

title.title: Title
title.description: A title giving an overview of the dataset.

description.title: Description
description.description: This is a brief narrative summary of the content of the dataset. The abstract should provide a clear and concise statement that enables the reader to understand the content of the data. Include the following: the main attributes, data sources, why it was created, what it can be used for if reused, any data quality issue. Do not use unexplained acronyms.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: List people who have been involved with the creation and management of the dataset. It is important to state who the creator (Author) was. Author is used for the person or organisation chiefly responsible for the intellectual content.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full name of the person or organisation.

orcid.title: ORCID
orcid.description: ORCID identifier URI for the person (e.g. https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000).

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of this agent in relation to the dataset.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The organisation the agent is affiliated with.

dateCreated.title: Date Created
dateCreated.description: Date the dataset was created, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of creation differs from the temporal coverage. For example, a dataset might have been created in February 2009 (2009-02-15) but the data was collected during the year 2008 (temporal coverage from 2008-01-01 to 2008-12-31).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Use the keywords feature to provide more specific terms that describe the dataset's content. These can be used to identify particular concepts, places, techniques, or any other relevant aspect that the dataset addresses. When possible, existing vocabularies should be used to source keywords. An example of global vocabulary is the Global Change Master Directory. Alternatively, GEMET, the GEneral Multilingual Environmental Thesaurus.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: The entity responsible for publishing the dataset. Defaults to Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao.

optional_additional_metadata.title: Optional additional metadata
optional_additional_metadata.description: Additional metadata fields. These fields are not required but recommended for completeness.

alternativeTitle.title: Alternative Title
alternativeTitle.description: Alternative titles for the dataset. Use this field for te reo Māori titles or other variant names.

language.title: Language
language.description: Specify the language(s) used in the dataset or its documentation (e.g. English, Te Reo Māori).

resourceIdentifier.title: Resource Identifier
resourceIdentifier.description: Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred

datasetVersion.title: Dataset Version
datasetVersion.description: Specify the dataset version if applicable. Examples include 1.0 (first release), 1.1 (minor update), 2.0 (major revision), or 2026-07 (date-based version).

dateModified.title: Date Modified
dateModified.description: The date the dataset was last modified or a new version released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Repeat for each version.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date the dataset was modified or a new version released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the dataset corresponding to this modification date.

audience.title: Audience / Intended Users
audience.description: The intended audience or expected users of the dataset.

relatedResources.title: Related Resources
relatedResources.description: Provide the named and links to publications, reports, protocols, software, websites, or other resources that help users understand or use this dataset. Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred. Use ADD ROW to add more items.

resource.title: Description of Resource
resource.description: A description of the relationship to the related resource.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred.

temporalCoverage.title: Temporal Coverage
temporalCoverage.description: The time span the dataset covers.

start.title: Start Date
start.description: Start of the temporal coverage period, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

end.title: End Date
end.description: End of the temporal coverage period, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if ongoing.

description.title: Temporal Description
description.description: Free-text description of the temporal coverage where precise dates are not available.

geographicCoverage.title: Extent of the resource
geographicCoverage.description: Defines the spatial (horizontal and vertical) and temporal region to which the content of the resource applies.

provenance.title: Provenance / Project Context
provenance.description: Briefly describe how the dataset was created. Include the project name, data collection methods, processing, quality assurance, or other significant steps used to produce the dataset. Where relevant, include cultural provenance, such as whakapapa or other contextual information important for Māori data.

sources.title: Derived From / Sources
sources.description: Describe the original data or other resources from which this dataset was derived or compiled. Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred. List one dataset or resource per row. Use ADD ROW to add more items.

source.title: Source Description
source.description: A description of the source resource or dataset.

uri.title: Source URI
uri.description: Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred.

isPartOf.title: Is Part Of
isPartOf.description: The collection or larger dataset this dataset belongs to (e.g. NZLRI).

collection.title: Collection Name
collection.description: The name of the collection or larger dataset this dataset is part of.

uri.title: Collection URI
uri.description: A URI identifying the collection or larger dataset (e.g. DOI, URL). Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred.

commentsIncludingReferences.title: Comments including References
commentsIncludingReferences.description: Provide additional information that helps users understand or use the dataset but is not captured elsewhere. This may include references to publications, explanatory comments, data citation information or other relevant notes.

rightsHolder.title: Rights Holder
rightsHolder.description: Identify the person or organisation that owns or controls the rights to this dataset if not Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao.

accessRights.title: Access Rights
accessRights.description: Information about who can access the dataset, or its embargo status.

licenseURI.title: License URI
licenseURI.description: Provide a URI to the license or agreement that governs use and reuse of the dataset. Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred.

licenseDetails.title: License Details
licenseDetails.description: Specify the license and agreement that governs use and reuse of the dataset. Include any data sharing agreements. Examples include CC BY 4.0 or a commercial or BSI-specific licence. For Māori data, this may include iwi or hapū agreements, partnership agreements, or other Māori data governance arrangements that define how the data may be accessed and used.

dataFormat.title: Data Format
dataFormat.description: The file format(s) of the dataset. If files use different file types, use dominant type (e.g. CSV, FASTA, GeoTIFF, Shape, NetCDF, instrument-specific formats).

dataLocation.title: Location of Data
dataLocation.description: Specify where the dataset can be found. Record the storage location or access point that enables others to locate the data, such as a shared drive, SharePoint site, data repository, database, cloud storage, or a public location (e.g. repository, DOI, landing page or download URL). If the metadata will be publicly available, do not include internal file paths or system details.

location.title: Data Location
location.description: A description of the location where the data is stored.

uri.title: Location URI
uri.description: Persistent identifiers (URI) (e.g. DOI or URL) preferred.
